footer.subject: Likambo:
footer.subjectPlaceholder: Kótia likambo ya nsango na yo

respect_dignity.name: Lokumu moko
respect_dignity.message: Liboso ya Nzambe, mwasi azali na makoki mpe lokumu ndenge moko na mobali. Komemya bokokani ezali kobatela bonsomi na ye ya kopona mpe likoki na ye ya koyokama.

respect_consent.name: Kondima na bonsomi
respect_consent.message: Soki akoki koloba « te » te mpo azali kobanga ndenge okoyanola, « ɛɛ » oyo ozali kozela ezali na ntina nini?

respect_boundaries.name: Komemya « te »
respect_boundaries.message: Kotungisa ye nsima ya koyoka « te » ezali kotinda ye na makasi andima. Bonsomi na ye ya kopona ezali na ntina koleka mawa na yo. Ndima eyano na ye.

respect_empathy.name: Komitia na esika na ye
respect_empathy.message: Kanisá ndenge okoyoka soki ozali na esika na ye, mpe yoká ye: makanisi na yo ekoki kozwa esika ya makambo oyo ye azali kokutana na yango te.

respect_freedom.name: Kolinga kozanga kokamba
respect_freedom.message: Kotala telefone na ye kozanga ndingisa to kopekisa ye kokutana na baninga ezali koyangela bomoi na ye. Soki ozali na zuwa, lobá ndenge ozali koyoka kozanga kosɛnga ye atika bonsomi na ye.

respect_anger.name: Nguya ya kimya
respect_anger.message: Limemya emonanaka mpe na makambo oyo oponi kosala te ntango osiliki.

respect_sexism.name: Koboya kotiola basi
respect_sexism.message: Lisɛki oyo ekitisaka basi ezali kofingisa ata soki bato nyonso baseki. Okoki koloba na baninga na yo: « Ezali kokitisa ye. Ezali kosekisa te. »

respect_privacy.name: Kobatela makambo na ye
respect_privacy.message: Ayebisaki yo likambo na ye ya sekele. Kondimela yo epesaki yo ndingisa ya kopanza yango te.

respect_solidarity.name: Kosalisa kozanga kotinda
respect_solidarity.message: Kosalisa ye ezali kotikela ye esika ya kozwa ekateli, kasi te kozwa ekateli na esika na ye.

respect_accountability.name: Kondima mokumba ya misala na yo
respect_accountability.message: Okoyeba ete obongwani ntango okosala ndenge mosusu liboso ya likambo oyo ezalaki kotungisa yo.

respect_happiness.name: Esengo na ye
respect_happiness.message: Kosepela komona ye azali kokola ezali mpe kosepela na makambo oyo azali kokokisa kozanga yo.

respect_fantasy.name: Ndɔtɔ
respect_fantasy.message: Kosangisa nzoto ezali likambo ya motuya koleka na bomoi te. Boboto, kotyelana motema mpe kozala penepene na motema ezali na motuya mingi koleka mpo na esengo oyo bozali kotonga elongo. Luká libosoliboso kozala na esengo mpe kosalisa ye azala na esengo mpe akola.

respect_worth.name: Motuya na yo
respect_worth.message: Kosangisa nzoto to te elakisi eloko te mpo na motuya na yo. Ozali na eloko ya komonisa te.

respect_tenderness.name: Boboto
respect_tenderness.message: Mbala mosusu esengo eutaka na makambo ya mike: moto oyo ayoki yo, kosɛka elongo, to kozala na moto oyo apesi yo kimya.

respect_desire.name: Mposa
respect_desire.message: Mabe etindaka yo ondima ete eloko moko te ezali na ntina koleka mposa na yo. Ata ozali na mposa ya nini, soki ezangi bwanya ya bolingo, mposa yango ekoki komema yo na bozoba mpe na mawa. Talá na motema: soki mposa na yo ezali ya kolinga, batelá mpe memyá moto mosusu libosoliboso.

respect_love.name: Bolingo
respect_love.message: Bolamu ya boyokani emonanaka mpe na bonsomi oyo moto na moto azali na yango ya kozala ndenge azali, ya koloba mpe ya koloba « te ».

respect_full_life.name: Bomoi ya litomba
respect_full_life.message: Boninga, kokela, kosalisana mpe esengo ya koyekola ekoki kopesa bomoi na yo ntina lokola bolingo to kosangisa nzoto.

respect_break_the_chain.name: Katá monyololo ya kobangisa basi na makambo ya nzoto
respect_break_the_chain.message: Komona ete kosimba moto na ndenge ya kosangisa nzoto kozanga ndingisa mpe kotungisa ye ezali makambo ya mike, ezali kolendisa kosangisa nzoto na makasi. Soki mobulu yango ekómeli moto ya libota na yo, bomoi na yo mpe eninganaka. Kozela te tii ekómela moto ya pene na yo. Lobá « te » na kotungisa bato na makambo ya kosangisa nzoto, batelá lotomo ya basi ya kozala na bomoi kozanga mobulu, mpe salisá baoyo bazali koloba makambo oyo bakutanaki na yango.

respect_no_manipulation.name: Boyá kosalela mayele mpo na koyangela moto
respect_no_manipulation.message: Bolingo ezali programɛ te, ezali mpe lisano te. Koluka kokanga moto na cage ya wolo ezali bozoba: ata esalemi na wolo, cage elongolaka bonsomi. Bolingo etambwisamaka na mayele te. Soki olingi moto, memyá bonsomi na ye ya kopona.

respect_no_perfidy.name: Boyá bokosi
respect_no_perfidy.message: Mbala mingi, masolo mpe makambo oyo tokabolaka kati na mibali ememyaka makambo ya sekele ya basi te. Liloba ya kosambwisa mwasi na makambo ya nzoto to kokabola fɔtɔ na ye ya sekele kozanga ndingisa esalaka ete azala na kimya te. Bongolá motema na yo: poná bolingo ya solo, oyo ememyaka makambo na bango ya sekele ata ntango bazali wana te.

respect_protect_without_control.name: Kobatela kozanga koyangela
respect_protect_without_control.message: Soki olingi kobatela ye, tuná ye nini azali na yango mposa. Kozwa ekateli na esika na ye ekoki kolongola bonsomi oyo olingaki kobatela.

respect_trust_not_debt.name: Kotyela motema ezali nyongo te
respect_trust_not_debt.message: Soki olobi « nsima ya nyonso oyo nasaleli yo » mpo andima, obongoli boboto na yo na kotindika ye na makasi.

respect_respect_in_absence.name: Limemya ata azali wana te
respect_respect_in_absence.message: Soki moninga akaboli fɔtɔ na ye ya sekele kozanga ndingisa, kokabola yango te. Lobá na moninga alongola yango. Limemya emonanaka mpe na makambo oyo oboyi kondima.

respect_listen_first.name: Yoká liboso ya komilongisa
respect_listen_first.message: Soki ayebisi yo ete obangisaki ye, kobanda te kolimbola mpo na nini asengelaki kobanga te. Yoká makambo oyo akutanaki na yango.

respect_faith_and_freedom.name: Kondima mpe bonsomi
respect_faith_and_freedom.message: Kobenga nkombo ya Nzambe te mpo ozwa epai na ye eloko oyo alingi kopesa yo te. Lisosoli mpe bonsomi na ye esengeli kozwa limemya lokola oyo ya yo.

respect_make_amends.name: Kobongisa kozanga kosɛnga
respect_make_amends.message: Okoki kondima mabe oyo osali kozanga kosɛnga ye alimbisa yo. Elembo ya liboso ya mbongwana ezali komemya ntaka oyo asɛngi.

respect_integrity.name: Bosembo
respect_integrity.message: Kokisá elaka na yo ata moto moko azali kotala te. Soki okoki kokokisa yango lisusu te, lobá solo.

respect_humility.name: Komikitisa
respect_humility.message: Soki moto asemboli yo, luká liboso koyeba nini okoki koyekola. Kondima libunga elongolaka motuya na yo te.

respect_healthy_boundaries.name: Mpiko ya kotya ndelo
respect_healthy_boundaries.message: Okoki koloba « te » na kimya, ata na baninga na yo. Komemya bato mosusu esɛngi te ete ondima makambo oyo ezali kosala yo mpasi.

respect_share_responsibilities.name: Kokabola mikumba
respect_share_responsibilities.message: Salá eteni na yo ya mosala ya mokolo na mokolo kozanga kozela ete akundwela yo yango. Kobongisa makambo liboso ezali mpe mosala.

respect_celebrate_success.name: Kosepela na elonga na ye
respect_celebrate_success.message: Sepelá na elonga na ye kozanga kokokanisa yango na oyo ya yo. Makoki na ye elongolaka eloko moko te na makoki na yo.

respect_consideration.name: Boboto na maloba
respect_consideration.message: Liboso ya kosɛka likambo ya mpasi oyo ayebisaki yo na sekele, kanisá mpo na nini ayebisaki yo yango: atyelaki yo motema.

respect_ask_for_help.name: Nguya ya kosɛnga lisalisi
respect_ask_for_help.message: Soki oyebi lisusu te ndenge ya kosala kozanga koyokisa moto mpasi, sololá na moto oyo otyelaka motema. Kosɛnga lisalisi ezali kozwa misala na yo na kilo.

respect_share_peace.name: Luká kimya mpe kabolá yango
respect_share_peace.message: Luká kimya na maloba mpe na misala na yo. Soki matata ebimi, yoká liboso ya koyanola mpe boyá kosambwisa moto. Kokabola kimya ezali mpe kotya ndelo soki moto azali kosala bato mosusu mabe.

respect_gods_light.name: Pole ya Nzambe
respect_gods_light.message: Batelá bolingo ya Nzambe lokola pole na yo, mpe bwanya na ye na motema na yo.

respect_valiant_hero.name: Elombe ya mpiko
respect_valiant_hero.message: Nzambe akopesa yo makasi: azali na yo. Elombe ya mpiko, kotikala mokangami ya mabunga ya kala te. Tongá bomoi na yo na bosembo, kondima mpe elikya, atako bitumba.

first_steps.name: TOMBOLÁ MOTÓ
first_steps.message: Ozali ekelamu kitoko! Litamboli ya liboso ezali ntango nyonso ya ntina!

move_now.name: NINGANA LELO!
move_now.message: Mosala ekobimisa nguya. Lekela liboso, koteleme te!

break_silence.name: BUKA KIMIA
break_silence.message: Mongongo na yo ezali na ntina. Loba, banda koyokana. Mokili ezali kozela yo!

persevere.name: KOTELEMA
persevere.message: Kotelema elongi talent. Lekela, ozali na nzela malamu!

release.name: KOMIPESA
release.message: Longola minyololo na yo. Tika oyo ezali kokanga yo.

stand_up.name: TELEMA!
stand_up.message: Telema! Ozali mobundi, champion. Kotikala na nse te!

jesus_loves.name: OLINGAMI
jesus_loves.message: Yesu alingi yo ndenge ozali. Bolingo na ye ezali na condition te mpe ezali ya libela.

halfway.name: NA KATI-KATI
halfway.message: Otamboli ndambo ya nzela! Lekela, oyo malamu ezali kolanda!

combo_master.name: MOKONZI YA BA COMBOS
combo_master.message: Combo ya kokamwa! Oyekosolá mayele ya kokangisa!

warrior.name: MOBUNDI YA POLE
warrior.message: Ozali mobundi! Mpiko na yo ezali kopesa molimo na mokili!

unstoppable.name: MOKOKI KOTELEMA TE
unstoppable.message: Eloko moko te ekoki kotelema yo! Ozali nguya ya nature!

master.name: MOKONZI YA NYONSO
master.message: Okómi na likolo! Ozali makasi mingi!

ultimate_trophy.name: TROPHÉE YA SUKA
ultimate_trophy.message: Etanda ya MAXIMUM ekómi! Ozali champion ya solo! Komona mokili inclusif ya Emmanuel.

messages.13: Etanda 13! Mabe ezali te mpo na yo!

treasures.1: Esengo ezali kopona oyo osalaka mokolo na mokolo. Pona yango lelo! ✨
treasures.2: Kondima eyaka na kati. Ozali na makambu nyonso oyo osengeli na yango. 💫
treasures.3: Tika makambu oyo okoki te ko contrôler. Bonsomi ezali ko zela yo! 🕊️
treasures.4: Limbolaka yo moko. Osalelaki malamu mingi na oyo oyebaki na ntango wana. 💚
treasures.5: Bima na kati ya sanduku na yo! Mokili ezali monene koléka ba peurs na yo. 🌍
treasures.6: Tambola, bina, zala na bomoi! Nzoto na yo ezali tempelo ya molimo na yo. 💃
treasures.7: Eloko moko te ezali mpasi mpo na moto oyo andimaka. Okoki kosala eloko nyonso! ⭐
treasures.8: Mpiko ezali kobanga te, ezali kotambola liboso atâ na kobanga. 🦁
treasures.9: Séka mpe yemba! Miziki ya motema na yo ebongolaka mokili. 🎵
treasures.10: Bina na mbula na kosobela! Bamopepe ekopesaka ntango nyonso. ☔
treasures.11: Moinda na yo ya kati elongaka makasi koléka molili nyonso. ✝️
treasures.12: Litambá moko na moko ezali na ntina. Kobela kotambola liboso, ozali ko progress! 👣
treasures.13: Ko ma malamu ebongolaka oyo ozali na yango ezala ekoki. Matôndi mpo lelo! 🙏
treasures.14: Ozali kelasi moko mpe monene! Sépaka mpo ozali nani! 🌟
treasures.15: Bolingo ebandaka na yo moko. Lingaka yo moko lokola olingami. ❤️
treasures.16: Kokweya ezali mateya oyo ezipi. Kobela koyeka! 📚
treasures.17: Mongongo na yo ezali na ntina. Lobáka na bosembo mpe mpiko. 🗣️
treasures.18: Moyo molái ezali lolenge moko ya bwanya. Makambu nyonso eyaka na ntango na yango. ⏳
treasures.19: Pémaka makasi. Ozali na bomoi mpe yango ezali kado! 🌬️
treasures.20: Baloti na yo ezali malamu. Luandaka yango na mposa mpe kondima! 🎯
treasures.21: Ozali makasi koléka oyo okanisaka. Talaka makambu nyonso oyo olemisaki! 💪
treasures.22: Kabolá koseka na yo. Ekoki kopelisa mokolo ya moto mosusu. 😊
treasures.23: Elikia ezali nkangelo ya molimo. Bômba elikia, ntango nyonso! ⚓
treasures.24: Bongola makanisi na yo, bongola bomoi na yo. Makambu nyonso ezali maloba ya komona! 👁️
treasures.25: Ozali nguya ya nature. Yâmbaka nguya na yo! 🌊
treasures.26: Boboto ezali nguya, ezali bolembu te. Zâlaka malamu na yo moko. 🤗
treasures.27: Mokolo na mokolo ezali libaku ya sika ya kobanda lisusu. Lelo ezali na ntina! 🌅
treasures.28: Obongi kozala na esengo. Tikâ moto te aloba makambu mosusu! 🎁
treasures.30: Ozali polele epai osengeli kozala. Tyaka motema na mosala. 🧭
treasures.31: Lisolo na yo esilaki nanu te. Malamu mingi ekoya! 📖
treasures.32: Sépaka elongi nyonso, ata mike. Ozali champion! 🏆
treasures.33: Kimia ya kati ezali ndingisa na yo ya kobotama. Séngelaka yango! ☮️
treasures.34: Mékaka kolota monene. Likolo ezali ebandeli kaka! ☁️
treasures.35: Opesaka bato motema mingi koléka oyo oyebaka. Kongelaka! ✨
treasures.36: Bomoi ezali kado. Fungolaka yango na kokamwa! 🎀
treasures.37: Ozali na nguya ya kokela bomoi oyo olingi. Banda lelo! 🎨
treasures.38: Tikâ oyo ekitisaka yo. Tambola pepépé, fyâka likokó! 🦅
treasures.39: Makoki na yo ezali pété te. Komitélaka yo moko te! 🚀
treasures.40: Ozali likamwisi ya bomoi. Kobwakáka yango te! 🌈
treasures.41: Kotyâka motema na yo moko ekoki koyeka. Salaka yango mokolo na mokolo! 💎
treasures.42: Ozali motongi ya destin na yo. Tongâka na bolingo! 🏗️
treasures.43: Yembâka nzembo na yo moko. Mokili esengeli na muziki na yo! 🎼
treasures.44: Opambolami mpe ozali lipamboli. Kabolá moinda na yo! 🕯️
treasures.45: Investissement malamu ezali na yo moko. Okoki! 💰
treasures.46: Kamwâka na makambu mike. Maji ezali bisika nyonso! ✨
treasures.47: Otíkálaki 100% ya mikolo na yo mabe. Ozali invincible! 🛡️
treasures.48: Zâlaka na bomoi mobimba. Lingaka makasi. Sékaka mingi. Yango nde bomoi! 🎭
treasures.49: Ozali mosala ya art oyo ezali ko sala. Zálaka na moyo moláiya yo moko! 🖼️
treasures.50: Okómáki na likokó! Kobela komata. Ozali extraordinaire! 🏔️
